Every time I try to lift my foot, I feel one twitch under my heel, and when I look up, more of them are pouring from a vent in the ceiling, dropping onto my shoulders and brushing against my neck. I’m screaming and clawing at the locked door with numb hands when I feel something thick and heavy winding tightly around my calf and another snake pressing its head against my bare throat.
user_input: I try to steady myself and peel the one off my calf while backing toward the door, but then I just can't handle the ceiling filling up with more of them and I squeeze my eyes shut until the dream cuts out.
source_suite: Trapped in a room full of snakes with severe phobia
